title: Los Angeles Taco Tour with To Live and Dine in LA Food Tours
includes: Interpretation of beautiful residential architecture, including Frank Lloyd Wright's Hollyhock House
Insights into Los Feliz's rich film history
Beautiful views of the Hollywood Sign and Griffith Observatory
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

The 3-hour tour is 2.5 miles in length. This distance is broken up with historic, cultural, and food stops along the way. To get to the Hollyhock House, we will walk up 130 steps. There are some inclines in the residential areas of the neighborhood. We walk down one public staircase of about 30 steps. Beyond this, the tour is mostly flat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Book direct to save and support our small business in the process! Visit our website - To Live and Dine in LA Food Tours

Get to know Los Feliz, a hip and highly walkable neighborhood in LA. Enjoy a wide variety of 5 tacos from spots that range from a classic Mexico City-style taqueria to a restaurant pushing the limits with their inventive mash-ups.

You'll enjoy tried-and-true community staples and fusion cuisine that will surprise and delight. Discover the area's rich film history that includes silent movie stars and Walt Disney, and beautiful residential architecture that is a microcosm of greater LA's domestic design. See LA's only UNESCO World Heritage Site and eat delicious tacos galore.

This 3-hour tour is great for locals/visitors, meat eaters, vegetarians, vegans & gluten-free guests. Perfect activity for a birthday celebration, bachelor(ette) party, or team building event for coworkers.

Please note: drinks are not included, nor is tour guide gratuity (15-20% recommended)
